parts.note_add: The catalogue calls it 'side turn lamp', but S-001 p22 wires it as the rear side marker (F-14 LH / F-15 RH): lit steady from the RG tail bus with the parking lights, not flashed by the turn circuit. Grounds at X-15 (confirm on the car).
Trade number 194 (T-3 1/4 wedge, W2.1x9.5d). Factory rating 12 V 3.8 W (S-005 BI-036-05, S-001 p22); a 194 is 14 V 0.27 A, 2 MSCP. Candela catalogue saved in datasheets/PT609.
Atkins Rotary sold replica R (FA01-51-551) and L (FA01-51-561) lenses at 20 USD each, now NLA; used OEM lenses turn up (autopart3, red lens, code 232-41786R), so plan on used ones.

S-001 p26 (H-11 luggage compartment light, 5 W): LY feed, constant from the X-04 15 A fuse via X-03; RB return to H-12 luggage compartment light switch, which closes to ground (confirm on the car). Works with the key out. Catalogue: GS & GSL only.
Mazda 0000-11-3022 is still sold as a current Mazda cargo lamp bulb (about 2.29 USD). No source gives the festoon length: measure the old bulb before buying another.

New FA01-66-122 still sold by Atkins Rotary (99.75 USD, in stock, 81-83 only). Covers E-01 (light, dimmer, passing, horn contact) and F-02 (turn and hazard) on S-001. On S-001 p20 the high-beam indicator hangs on RL and the 1985 manual labels RL high and RY low, the reverse of headlights-popups-illumination.md: confirm on the car.
